verdict.rationale: Elicit ships its own background automation features. Alerts monitor topics and email you instantly when a new relevant paper is found [elicit-docs-3][elicit-docs-15]. Routines go further: they act on what they find, filtering on criteria, updating an artifact, or writing a summary [elicit-docs-80]. However, Routines appear in only one line of evidence, and nothing shows how they are set up, scheduled or triggered, or how far their autonomy extends. Missing for 10: documentation of Routine setup, scheduling and triggers; detail on what actions a Routine can perform; independent or hands-on confirmation that background automations work.
